title: Digital Library
summary: Build a shelf of books and notes that students can search and save.

steps.title: Add the header
steps.objective: Start the Digital Library screen with a title bar.
steps.concept: A header sits at the top of a screen and tells people where they are.
steps.expected: A title bar appears at the top of the phone.

expect.label: A Header sits in the Header zone of Digital Library
expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

hints: Find the glowing Header tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Header zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Header, then tap the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Name your screen
steps.objective: Give the screen a clear title.
steps.concept: The header will say “Digital Library”. A clear title means nobody gets lost.

expect.label: The header says exactly: Digital Library

hints: Click the header on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.
Type exactly: Digital Library

steps.title: Add the library
steps.concept: The library shows books with a search box. Starter books are built in, and you add your own. Students can save favourites to My shelf.
steps.expected: A library panel appears in the Body zone.

expect.label: A Library sits in the Body zone of Digital Library
expect.fail: Drag the Library tool onto the glowing Body zone.

hints: Find the glowing Library tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Body zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Library, then tap the glowing Body zone.

steps.title: Add your first book
steps.objective: Put a book on the shelf.
steps.concept: ADD BOOK needs a title, an author with BY, and a tag with TAG. The tag helps with searching.
steps.expected: The library shows 1 book of yours.

cmds: ADD BOOK "My Science Notes" BY "Class 7" TAG "Science"

expect.label: The library has at least 1 book you added

hints: ADD BOOK "title" BY "author" TAG "tag".
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Add two more books
steps.concept: A good library has books on different subjects. Use your own titles and tags.
steps.expected: The library shows 3 books of yours.

cmds: ADD BOOK "Maths Revision Guide" BY "Mr Ahmed" TAG "Maths"

expect.label: The library has at least 3 books you added

hints: Two ADD BOOK lines, one per line.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Final style check: every colour, border, shadow and style
steps.objective: Give your screens the same colours, shapes and shadows as the model app.
steps.concept: Colours were chosen while you built each element. Now finish the whole look: every colour, background, border, corner, shadow and text style below must match the model app you tried at the start. Items you already set show a tick.
steps.expected: Your screens look exactly like the model app.
hints: Click the element on the phone first. The style box (Choose colours, borders and corners) opens by itself.
Follow the sub-steps one by one: each says which row to use and which option to click. The red dot shows where.
Text alignment and weight are in the Properties panel (right) under “Text and layout”.

steps.title: Run and use your library
steps.objective: Search the shelf and save a book.
steps.concept: Search filters by title, author or tag. Tap the plus button to save a book to My shelf.
steps.expected: You search for a book and see it on My shelf.

expect.name: libSearched
expect.label: You used the search box
expect.fail: Type in the search box in the running app.

expect.name: bookSaved
expect.label: You saved a book to My shelf
expect.fail: Tap the plus button next to a book.

subs.t: Press Run Project in the top bar
Type in the search box (try: sci)
Tap the + button to save a book

hints: Press Run Project.
Type a few letters in the search box.
Tap the plus button next to a book.

objectives: Add your own books with an author and a tag.
Search the shelf by title, author or tag.
Save favourite books to My shelf.

mcqs.q: What does a library search box compare your words with?
a: The title, author and tag of each book
mcqs.why: Searching looks for matching text in the book details.

mcqs.q: What is a tag on a book?
a: A short label that groups books by topic
mcqs.why: Tags make books easier to find.

mcqs.q: Why can a student save a book to a shelf?
a: To keep a personal list of the books they want
mcqs.why: Saved items give each user their own collection.

mcqs.q: Why should search ignore capital letters?
a: So "Maths" and "maths" both find the same book
mcqs.why: Users do not type in a fixed style.

mcqs.q: Why show a message when a search finds nothing?
a: It tells the user the search worked but nothing matched
mcqs.why: A clear message is better than a blank screen.
